Show HN: Rowboat – AI coworker that turns your work into a knowledge graph (OSS) Hi HN,

AI agents that can run tools on your machine are powerful for knowledge work, but they’re only as useful as the context they have. Rowboat is an open-source, local-first app that turns your work into a living knowledge graph (stored as plain Markdown with backlinks) and uses it to accomplish tasks on your computer.

Show HN: JavaScript-first, open-source WYSIWYG DOCX editor We needed a JS-first WYSIWYG DOCX editor and couldn't find a solid OSS option, most were either commercial or abandoned.

As an experiment, we gave Claude Code the OOXML spec, a concrete editor architecture, and a Playwright-based test suite. The agent iterated in a (Ralph) loop over a few nights and produced a working editor from scratch.

Core text editing works today. Tables and images are functional but still incomplete. MIT licensed.

problems.title: Show HN: Distr 2.0 – A year of learning how to ship to customer environments
problems.content:

problems.title: I used the app for a week and to be honest it's far from suitable. Task capture is fast and natural
problems.content: I used the app for a week and to be honest it's far from suitable. Task capture is fast and natural language works great. Kanban is not correct as tasks don't move to the done column on completion. The sync is completely broken on android which I discovered after a few days of work, as the web app was showing a completely different state. Manually syncing did nothing. This is a simple and fundamental feature that should not break so easily. I am now using obsidian with the TaskNotes plugin.

problems.content: Used this app for years and loved it but the last several months, there have been relentless bugs in the app that haven't gone away even after reinstalling and clearing cache. my today page can't scroll to the bottom, adding a task from the today page disappears, and syncing between mobile and web/desktop version is messed up despite being logged in with an Internet connection and pushing the sync. it's honestly embarrassing and sad for such a simple app.
